_doc: Every threshold the v3 validators and QA gates use, with its source. Edit HERE (not in the code). Sources: LOOK_REPORT 1.1 (his NEW-8 medians), KIT_CONTRACT (DETAIL STANDARD, speed budget), LESSONS 29/35/48/49, memory feedback_shorts_pacing_clarity / feedback_shorts_story_and_motion, CHANNEL_STYLE_BIBLE 7 (captions).

film._min_locations: LOOK_REPORT 0 #9: about 6 distinct places + light states per video; our clown had 3
film._framing: LESSONS 48: a new framing about every 2.5 s; LESSONS 29/35: holds 2.5-4 s are fine, nothing frantic
film._snaps: LESSONS 29: at most 2 comic snaps per film
film._cam: % of frame per frame (look_metrics formula). His NEW-8 median 0.72, 43 % of frames > 1 %/f, still 17 %. The owner's calm cap: peak <= ~45 px/f at 1080 = 4.2 %/f (LESSONS 35). The fast-share target is lowered to 30 % on purpose (owner pacing).
film._shot_cam_min: LESSONS 48: no frame under 0.5 px/f except a deliberate freeze (camera.freeze: true)

preset_speed_prior._doc: planned median %/f per preset when neither the bible nor CORE's camSpeedStats gives one (WORKFLOW's estimate, replace with measured values from kit/core/NOTES.md when CORE logs them)

qa._doc: qa_gates.py targets on a rendered animatic / preview / final (look_metrics.py per shot). PASS band = target (+-). Source: LOOK_REPORT 1.1 NEW-8 medians; pilot measured chroma 23.3, shadow chroma 14.4, soft 1.8 %.
qa._local_strong: his 30 %, our films 7-16 %; the contract wants >= 3 moving things; per-shot floor 12 % (film target >= 20 %)
qa._loop: mean abs RGB difference (0-255) between frame 0 and the last frame at 180x320
